docs.title: NSID Staff Console Guide
docs.text:
This guide explains how to use the NSID staff console — the shared web app for Ministry of Education (MoE) administrators and recognized education institutions.

The console runs under /admin/ (for example http://localhost:3000/admin/ in local development).

docs.title: Who this is for
docs.text: Audience Typical tasks MoE admin Manage NSIDs, institutions, users, audit, and national reference data Institution user Maintain your school’s student roster, import CSV, and issue or link NSIDs

docs.title: How to use this guide
docs.text:
1. Start with Getting started (login, 2FA, and which menus you see).
  2. Follow the MoE admin or Institution portal section that matches your role.
  3. Each page covers one sidebar menu (or a major nested action), with steps and screenshots.

docs.title: Related material
docs.text:
• Engineering issuance model: see docs/institution-fsid-issuance.md in the repository (not part of this MkDocs site).
  • Public student self-serve portal is a separate application and is not covered here.

docs.title: Sign in
docs.text:
1. Open the staff console (local default: http://localhost:3000/admin/).
  2. Enter your email and password.
  3. If your account requires two-factor authentication, complete Setup 2FA or Verify 2FA when prompted.
  4. After a successful sign-in you land on Dashboard.

docs.title: Other account flows
docs.text: Action Where Forgot password Link on the login page → email reset link Activate invited account Link from your invitation email (/activate) Sign out User menu in the header → Sign out

docs.title: What you see in the sidebar
docs.text:
Menus are permission-based. You and a colleague may see different items after the same login URL.

If you have… You typically see… MoE admin permissions (institution:manage, fsid:*, user:*) Dashboard, NSID group, Manage institutions, User Management, Reference, Settings. Institution portal links are hidden. Institution permissions (institution:read / institution:issue) without manage Dashboard, Institution portal, Students (if you can issue), Settings

docs.title: Permission cheatsheet (sidebar)
docs.text: Menu Permission Dashboard Always (authenticated) NSIDs / Fayda sessions / Access sessions / Audit fsid:read Issue NSID fsid:issue Issuance history institution:manage Manage institutions institution:manage Institution portal institution:read (institution users only) Students institution:issue (institution users only) Users / Roles user:read Invite user:create Reference / Settings Always (authenticated)

docs.title: Shared console, different roles
docs.text:
MoE staff and institution staff use the same login page. After authentication, the sidebar and route guards decide which portal you work in.

  • MoE admins manage institutions nationally and cannot open the institution-only portal routes.
  • Institution users only see and edit their own institution’s student roster.

docs.title: MoE admin overview
docs.text: Use this section when you administer NSID nationally: identities, institutions, users, and audit.

docs.title: Sidebar map
docs.text: Sidebar Guide page Dashboard Dashboard NSID → NSIDs NSIDs NSID → Issue NSID Issue NSID NSID → Fayda sessions Fayda sessions NSID → Access sessions Access sessions NSID → Audit Audit NSID → Issuance history Issuance history Institutions → Manage institutions Manage institutions User Management → Users Users User Management → Invite Users User Management → Roles Roles Reference Reference Settings Settings

docs.title: Typical workflows
docs.text:
1. Register an institution → invite institution users → optionally create an API integration.
  2. Issue an NSID for a citizen via Fayda (admin channel), or review sessions and audit.
  3. Search NSIDs and open a detail record to see linked institutions and history.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Review student portal OTP / profile access sessions (masked phone, status, expiry). Token hashes are not shown.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with fsid:read.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → NSID → Access sessions (/access-sessions).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-access-sessions.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-access-sessions.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Browse or reload the list.
  2. Use the list for support investigation (session status and timing). There is no staff “approve access” action on this page — it is read-only.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Search NSID audit events (requested, verified, issued, institution actions, and related types) for compliance and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with fsid:read.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → NSID → Audit (/audit-events).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-audit.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-audit.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Search / filter events when filters are available.
  2. Reload to refresh.
  3. Read event type, related session or NSID, detail text, and timestamp. The table is read-only.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: High-level counts and charts for NSID activity so MoE staff can spot volume and status at a glance.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Every authenticated user. Charts and NSID metrics appear when you have fsid:read. Institution-only users may see institution-oriented stats instead of the full MoE dashboard.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Dashboard (/dashboard).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Review summary cards (assignments, sessions, recent issuance windows).
  2. Use Refresh (if shown) to reload statistics.
  3. Open related lists from cards or charts when links are available (for example NSIDs or institutions).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Monitor staff and portal Fayda verification / issuance sessions (status, provider transaction, verified fields, outcome).

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with fsid:read. Cancelling a session requires fsid:issue.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → NSID → Fayda sessions (/issuance-sessions).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-fayda-sessions.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-fayda-sessions.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Filter or search by status when available.
  2. Reload the list.
  3. Open a session to view detail (status, consent, provider, verified identity, issued NSID).
  4. On a non-issued session, use Cancel session (if you have issue permission) to stop an abandoned flow.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Browse and open issued NSID assignments. Raw Fayda (FIN) numbers are not shown in staff views.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with fsid:read.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → NSID → NSIDs (/fsids).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Search by name or NSID value using the search box.
  2. Reload the table when you need fresh data.
  3. Open a row to view NSID detail (identity summary, Fayda linked flag, issuing institutions, access sessions, audit events).
  4. Click Issue NSID (requires fsid:issue) to start a new admin issuance — see Issue NSID.

docs.title: Detail page notes
docs.text:
• Issuing institutions lists every institution link for that NSID.
  • Access sessions and audit events are read-only lists for support and investigation.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Register and maintain education institutions, their users, student rosters (admin view), and API integrations.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with institution:manage.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Institutions → Manage institutions (/institutions).

docs.title: List actions
docs.text:
1. Search / filter institutions.
  2. Reload the table.
  3. Click Register institution to open the create form (/institutions/new).
  4. Open a row to open institution detail.

docs.title: Register institution
docs.text:
1. Enter name, code, type, and active status as required.
  2. Save. The institution appears in the list.

docs.title: Institution detail
docs.text: Typical tabs / sections:

docs.title: Details
docs.text:
1. Review institution fields.
  2. Edit and Save when you need to update name, code, type, or active flag.

docs.title: Users
docs.text:
1. Invite user to this institution (email / membership).
  2. Activate or deactivate memberships when staff leave or return.

docs.title: Students
docs.text:
1. Browse the institution’s roster (scoped to that institution).
  2. Export CSV with optional field and NSID filters.
  3. Import CSV — opens the admin import flow for this institution.
  4. Add student to create a single roster row (student number is unique per institution).

docs.title: Integration
docs.text:
1. Create integration to issue client credentials for a SIS.
  2. Copy the client secret when shown (it is displayed once).
  3. Toggle integration active / inactive.

docs.title: Issued NSIDs
docs.text: Review NSIDs already linked to this institution.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: View institution-linked NSID issuances across institutions (who issued, when, which method).

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with institution:manage (MoE admins).

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → NSID → Issuance history (/issuance-history).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-issuance-history.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-issuance-history.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Page through the history list.
  2. Use rows to identify institution, method, and timing for support or reporting.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Issue an NSID for a person through Fayda verification using the ADMIN channel (no institution roster required).

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with fsid:issue.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → NSID → Issue NSID (/fsids/issue).

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Confirm consent is recorded as required by the form.
  2. Enter the person’s FIN (Fayda) when prompted.
  3. Continue to open Fayda verification (redirect / popup depending on environment).
  4. After verification succeeds, review demographics returned from Fayda (name, date of birth, gender, photo when available).
  5. Click Generate NSID to create or retrieve the lifelong NSID.
  6. Optionally continue to issue for another person.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• If Fayda verification fails or the session expires, start a new issuance from this page.
  • Track in-progress attempts under Fayda sessions.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Maintain national lookup tables used by the system (for example nationalities). This is MoE reference data administration, not end-user help content.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: All authenticated users can open Reference; create/edit/delete actions depend on backend permissions for reference management.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → Reference (/references, redirects to a default key such as nationalities).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-reference.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-reference.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Select a reference category from the page navigation.
  2. Add a new entry.
  3. Edit an existing row.
  4. Delete or toggle active when those controls are shown.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Browse defined roles and their permissions. This screen is informational for operators who assign access via invites and user forms.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with user:read.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text:
Sidebar → User Management → Roles (/roles).

Screenshot placeholder: admin-roles.png — capture from the live console and save to assets/screenshots/admin-roles.png.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Search / filter roles.
  2. Reload the list.
  3. Review role names and permissions. Creating custom roles in the UI is not part of the current operator flow (read-only list).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: View your signed-in account and manage password / 2FA for your own user.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: All authenticated users.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Settings (/settings).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Review account identity (email and roles as displayed).
  2. Update password with current and new password fields.
  3. Disable 2FA only if your policy allows and the control is shown — prefer keeping 2FA enabled for admin accounts.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Manage MoE and staff user accounts: list, invite, create, edit, activate/deactivate, and delete (subject to your permissions).

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text:
• List / roles: user:read
  • Invite / create: user:create
  • Update actions: user:update (as configured)

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → User Management → Users (/users).

docs.title: List actions
docs.text:
1. Search / filter users.
  2. Open Invite or Add new when you have create permission.
  3. On a row: Edit, activate/deactivate, or Delete when available.

docs.title: Invite a user
docs.text:
Sidebar → User Management → Invite (/users/invite), or use the invite button from the users list / institution detail.

  1. Enter the invitee’s email and role / institution membership as required by the form.
  2. Send the invitation. The user completes activation from their email link.

docs.title: Create or edit a user
docs.text:
1. Create: /users/new — fill account fields and save.
  2. Edit: open a user → Edit (/users/{id}/edit) — update fields and save.

docs.title: Institution portal overview
docs.text: Use this section when you work for a recognized institution. You only see and change your institution’s students and issuance activity.

docs.title: Sidebar map
docs.text:
Sidebar Guide page Dashboard Shared Getting started; institution users land on Dashboard then open the portal Institutions → Institution portal Portal home Institutions → Students Students (from Students) Import Import students (from Students) Student detail / Issue Student detail and Issue NSID Settings Settings

MoE Manage institutions and national NSID admin menus are not shown to institution-only accounts.

docs.title: Typical workflows
docs.text:
1. Import or add students to your roster (student number unique within your school).
  2. Open a student → Issue NSID → complete Fayda → generate or Approve & link when names differ but you confirm the match.
  3. Export CSV for reporting (with or without NSID, date filters).

docs.title: Scope reminder
docs.text: Roster rows belong to one institution. Another school cannot see your students, even if the same person later holds an NSID linked to multiple institutions.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Institution landing page with roster / issuance summary and a quick path into Students.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with institution:read who are not MoE institution managers (institutionPortalOnly nav).

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Institutions → Institution portal (/institution-portal).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Review stats and recent issued NSIDs for your institution.
  2. Open Students (requires institution:issue) to manage the roster — see Students.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Manage your own account password and 2FA while signed in as an institution user. Same Settings page as MoE staff; sidebar otherwise shows institution menus.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: All authenticated users.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Settings (/settings).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Review your account email and roles.
  2. Update password.
  3. Manage 2FA according to your institution’s security policy.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Edit a roster record and run institution-channel Fayda issuance or approve a soft identity match to link an existing NSID.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Institution users with access to Students (institution:issue).

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Students list → open a student (/institution-portal/students/{id}).

docs.title: Edit roster
docs.text:
1. Click Edit.
  2. Update name parts, student number, date of birth, gender, phone, email, eligibility.
  3. Save. Duplicate student numbers within your institution are rejected.

docs.title: Fayda identity card
docs.text: When verification has run, the page shows verified name, date of birth, gender, Fayda subject, picture, and verified-at time stored on the student.

docs.title: Issue NSID
docs.text:
Shown when the student is eligible and does not already have an NSID.

  1. Click Issue NSID.
  2. Confirm consent and enter FIN when asked.
  3. Complete Fayda verification.
  4. Review the verified identity against the roster.
  5. If it matches, Generate NSID (create or retrieve) and link to your institution.
  6. If demographics differ, review the similarity score and use Approve & link student when you confirm it is the same person. There is no reject action on this soft-match path — leave without approving if you are unsure.

docs.title: Already has NSID
docs.text: If the student already has an NSID, the Issue control is hidden. Use the displayed NSID value and Fayda card for reference.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Bulk create or update roster rows from a CSV file. Existing student numbers in your institution are updated; new numbers are created. Duplicate numbers inside the same file are reported as errors.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with institution:issue (your institution only). MoE admins can run the same flow from an institution detail page for a chosen school.

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Students list → Import CSV (/institution-portal/students/import), or continue into an import detail (.../import/{id}).

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Download template to get the required headers and a sample row.
  2. Fill rows: First Name, Middle Name (optional), Last Name, Student Number, Gender (Male/Female), Date of Birth (YYYY-MM-DD), Phone, Email, Eligible (Yes/No).
  3. Upload the CSV. Validation runs asynchronously.
  4. Review preview and errors (invalid rows, duplicates in file).
  5. When validation succeeds, Start processing.
  6. Watch progress; download the error CSV if some rows failed.
  7. Return to Students to confirm imported records.

docs.title: Rules
docs.text:
• Imports are bound to your membership institution (or the institution selected by an MoE admin).
  • (institution, student number) is unique — the same number cannot exist twice in one school.
  • Uploader is recorded for audit (uploadedBy / createdBy on new rows).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Maintain your institution’s student roster: search, add, export, import, and open a student for editing or NSID issuance.

docs.title: Who sees it
docs.text: Users with institution:issue (institution portal only).

docs.title: How to open
docs.text: Sidebar → Institutions → Students (/institution-portal/students).

docs.title: Actions
docs.text:
1. Search by name or student number; reload when needed.
  2. Add student — enter name parts, student number, date of birth, gender, optional phone/email, eligibility. Student number must be unique within your institution.
  3. Export CSV — choose fields, with/without NSID, and optional issued-date range, then download.
  4. Import CSV — opens the import wizard; see Import students.
  5. Open a student row to view/edit and issue — see Student detail and Issue NSID.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Issue NSID is available on the student detail page when the student is eligible and does not already have an NSID linked.
  • Export and list data never leave your institution’s scope.
